name: Gradefes (Spain)
description: Divided by a blue band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, light grey-white above and purple below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gradefes (a cross, a lion and a bridge above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Gradefes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
